sections.Profile:
"Pirate Gold" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company on January 14, 1969. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two kick-out holes, and a distinctive horseshoe lane. The artwork, designed by Christian Marche, showcases a pirate theme.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1969

- Type: Electro-Mechanical
